lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਕੀ ਧਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ekas charanee je chit laavahi lab lobh kee dhaavasitaa ||3||
lines.translation: If you focus your consciousness on the Feet of the One Lord, what reason would you have to chase after greed? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਚਸਿ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: japas nira(n)jan rachas manaa ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Immaculate Lord, and saturate your mind with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਪਟੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe bolahi jogee kapat ghanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Why, O Yogi, do you make so many false and deceptive claims? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੀ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਆਣਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਣੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kamalee ha(n)s iaanaa meree meree karat bihaaneetaa ||
lines.translation: The body is wild, and the mind is foolish. Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, your life is passing away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਗੀ ਦਾਝੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: pranavat naanak naagee daajhai phir paachhai pachhutaaneetaa ||4||3||15||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, when the naked body is cremated, then you will come to regret and repent. ||4||3||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee chetee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aukhadh ma(n)tr mool man ekai je kar driR chit keejai re ||
lines.translation: O mind, there is only the One medicine, mantra and healing herb - center your consciousness firmly on the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke paap karam ke kaatanahaaraa leejai re ||1||
lines.translation: Take to the Lord, the Destroyer of the sins and karma of past incarnations. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man eko saahib bhaaee re ||
lines.translation: The One Lord and Master is pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere teen gunaa sa(n)saar samaavahi alakh na lakhanaa jaaee re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In Your three qualities, the world is engrossed; the Unknowable cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਹਮ ਤਉ ਪੰਡ ਉਚਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakar kha(n)d maaiaa tan meethee ham tau pa(n)d uchaaee re ||
lines.translation: Maya is so sweet to the body, like sugar or molasses. We all carry loads of it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੀ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਜੁ ਟੂਕਸਿ ਮੂਸਾ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raat aneree soojhas naahee laj tookas moosaa bhaaee re ||2||
lines.translation: In the dark of the night, nothing can be seen. The mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life, O Siblings of Destiny! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh karahi tetaa dukh laagai guramukh milai vadaaee re ||
lines.translation: As the self-willed manmukhs act, they suffer in pain. The Gurmukh obtains honor and greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo tin keeaa soee hoaa kirat na metiaa jaaee re ||3||
lines.translation: Whatever He does, that alone happens; past actions cannot be erased. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਊਣੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: subhar bhare na hovahi oone jo raate ra(n)g laaee re ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with, and committed to the Lord's Love, are filled to overflowing; they never lack anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee pa(n)k hovai je naanak tau mooRaa kichh paaee re ||4||4||16||
lines.translation: If Nanak could be the dust of their feet, then he, the ignorant one, might also obtain some. ||4||4||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee chetee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ਕਤ ਕੇਰਾ ਕਿਦੂ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਹਮ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kat kee maaee baap kat keraa kidoo thaavahu ham aae ||
lines.translation: Who is our mother, and who is our father? Where did we come from?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਜਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਿਪਜੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: agan bi(n)b jal bheetar nipaje kaahe ka(n)m upaae ||1||
lines.translation: We are formed from the fire of the womb within, and the bubble of water of the sperm. For what purpose are we created? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere saahibaa kaun jaanai gun tere ||
lines.translation: O my Master, who can know Your Glorious Virtues?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahe na jaanee augan mere ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My own demerits cannot be counted. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਹਮ ਚੀਨੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਸੂ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kete rukh birakh ham cheene kete pasoo upaae ||
lines.translation: I took the form of so many plants and trees, and so many animals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਗ ਕੁਲੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਖ ਉਡਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kete naag kulee mahi aae kete pa(n)kh udaae ||2||
lines.translation: Many times I entered the families of snakes and flying birds. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ ਭੰਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hat patan bij ma(n)dar bha(n)nai kar choree ghar aavai ||
lines.translation: I broke into the shops of the city and well-guarded palaces; stealing from them, I snuck home again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਿਛਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: agahu dekhai pichhahu dekhai tujh te kahaa chhapaavai ||3||
lines.translation: I looked in front of me, and I looked behind me, but where could I hide from You? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਮ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tat teerath ham nav kha(n)d dekhe hat patan baajaaraa ||
lines.translation: I saw the banks of sacred rivers, the nine continents, the shops and bazaars of the cities.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਤਕੜੀ ਤੋਲਣਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: lai kai takaRee tolan laagaa ghat hee mahi vanajaaraa ||4||
lines.translation: Taking the scale, the merchant begins to weigh his actions within his own heart. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਤੇਤੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jetaa samu(n)d saagar neer bhariaa tete augan hamaare ||
lines.translation: As the seas and the oceans are overflowing with water, so vast are my own sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਹਰ ਉਪਾਵਹੁ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਥਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa karahu kichh mihar upaavahu dubade pathar taare ||5||
lines.translation: Please, shower me with Your Mercy, and take pity upon me. I am a sinking stone - please carry me across! ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅੜਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਤਪੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਗੈ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeaRaa agan baraabar tapai bheetar vagai kaatee ||
lines.translation: My soul is burning like fire, and the knife is cutting deep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੬॥੫॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: pranavat naanak hukam pachhaanai sukh hovai din raatee ||6||5||17||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, recognizing the Lord's Command, I am at peace, day and night. ||6||5||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ਕੈ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rain gavaaee soi kai divas gavaaiaa khaai ||
lines.translation: The nights are wasted sleeping, and the days are wasted eating.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: heere jaisaa janam hai kaudee badale jaai ||1||
lines.translation: Human life is such a precious jewel, but it is being lost in exchange for a mere shell. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam na jaaniaa raam kaa ||
lines.translation: You do not know the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mooRe phir paachhai pachhutaahi re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You fool - you shall regret and repent in the end! ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਰਣੀ ਧਰੇ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਚਾਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anataa dhan dharanee dhare anat na chaahiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: You bury your temporary wealth in the ground, but how can you love that which is temporary?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਤ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਨ ਜੋ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਆਏ ਅਨਤ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anat kau chaahan jo gae se aae anat gavaai ||2||
lines.translation: Those who have departed, after craving for temporary wealth, have returned home without this temporary wealth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapan leeaa je milai taa sabh ko bhaagath hoi ||
lines.translation: If people could gather it in by their own efforts, then everyone would be so lucky.
